reason: The native map-read probe now takes its clear-tile expectations (IsSnowTile, GetClearDensity, GetClearCounter, the four GetFence sides, GetFieldType, GetIndustryIndexOfField) from MapLeafOracle, filled by ObserveMapLeaves from the original clear_map.h accessors, in place of the ClearServices readers and the FieldFences/FieldGround records this PR deletes from Rust and C++ (#963 decision 3). The nine lines are those observations and their two oracle fields; the deleted C++ lambdas and records are glue, not fork test C++, so the counter nets one line.
existing_alternatives: A Rust test cannot read the live C++ map through the original accessors, and keeping the ClearServices readers would leave carriers for one call site in a finished file. No line of the probe is orphaned by the change: ground_protocol.hpp and clear_map.h stay in use.
retirement_condition: Map ownership moves to Rust and the map-read probe, which compares Rust's in-place reads with the native accessors over the C++ map, is deleted.
